judge.rationale: The candidate implements the core Ajv validation and caching logic in `ToolRegistry` along with good unit tests, but fails several explicit acceptance criteria and build/lint gates. First, the candidate passes `{strict: false}` to `new Ajv(...)`, which causes Ajv to ignore unknown `type` values at compile time instead of throwing, breaking the `throws when registering a tool with an invalid inputSchema` test. Second, it uses `as any` in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` and `registry.test.ts` (instead of importing `{Ajv}` as a named export), and leaves an un-cited test file `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts` as well as `.lore/dod.md`, which will fail ESLint (`--max-warnings 0` and `re-lint/require-spec-link`). Finally, the `.specify/spec.md` update omits the required details about rejections returning a tool result, extra properties passing through unmodified, and the tool-round bound stopping retries, while `adrs/ADR-002-response-validation.md` and `package.json` version were modified outside the scope of the ticket.
